notes.shape: Adversarial probe 1 of 3 (design thread T15). Systematic synonym rotation at low density: four substitutions across a 77-word passage, roughly one every nineteen words. c08, c09 and c10 share one source page and differ only in rotation density, which is what makes density the single variable.
notes.rubric: C1 holds. C2 holds: the rotation changes words, not the enumerated structure the source chose. C3 holds: no attribution. C4 holds: swapping four words is not doing work the source does not do, which is the whole reason rotation is an evasion rather than a rewrite.
notes.measured: fingerprint.mjs at k=5: containment 0.473, jaccard 0.232, longest matched span 22 words at local lines 6-7, five spans in total. BOTH limbs of the separation rule fire.
notes.tier_reason: fingerprint-confirmed. At this density the rotation costs the attacker nothing and buys nothing: long unrotated runs survive and the span limb alone would carry the finding.
